messages:
maria: quick ping1 pushed a small update to the prompt-sets -> evals compact view addressing copy + a11y. can ppl glance? need to lock before eng handoff.
jon: link: https://figma.com/file/compact-copy-a11y (preview)
rachel: skimmed. main thing: we use 'regressions' in header but 'changes' in table. feels inconsistent. maybe 'Changes' as the neutral header and badge 'Regression' only on negative deltas.
maria: agree. neutral header 'Changes' + 'Regression' badges for score drops. i'll update.
paul: accessibility nit: when a row expands, screenreader should announce "Expanded <test name>, score delta -0.08". add aria-expanded and aria-live updates.
sara: microcopy: bulk CTA reads 'Approve selected' which feels clunky. options: 'Approve runs' or just 'Approve'. prefer 'Approve runs' for clarity.
jon: i prefer 'Approve runs' too. also add a tabbable toast with 'Undo' after bulk actions, role="status" and aria-live polite.
rachel: compact mode hides per-test comments; instead of fully hiding, show a comment dot that opens a flyout on keyboard enter. aria-label = "Open comments for <test>".
ux-bot: Suggestion: Add pre-approve validations: missing prompts, empty test inputs, zero tests in suite. Severity: warning vs error. Non-critical warnings show 'Approve anyway'.
paul: reduce-motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand/collapse. also ensure color is not sole indicator for score drops (add icon/label).
maria: great — action list: 1) header -> 'Changes', 2) CTA -> 'Approve runs', 3) add tabbable undo toast, 4) comment-dot flyout with keyboard support, 5) pre-approve validation modal with warning vs error. i'll update figma/spec and ping when done. thanks!
